turns.rephrase: I mean: find the calls scheduled at 5.

turns.text: Please see who the first one is with.
turns.rephrase: I mean: pick the first of them, then see who it is with.

turns.gold:
PROCEDURE person_on_call_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
turns.name: person_on_call_at
